definitions.meaning: Peace secured by law at a public assembly, the violation of which had to be compensated twofold

quotations.old_english: Ciricfriþ II. gylde; mæthlfriþ II. gylde

source_text: mæþel-friþ, es; n. Peace secured by law at a public assembly, the violation of which had to be compensated twofold :-- Ciricfriþ II. gylde; mæthlfriþ II. gylde, Ll. Lbmn, 3, 6.
